summary: The registrant, PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia, filed a Form 6-K notifying the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK) of a temporary appointment of a new Head of Internal Audit Unit. Mr. Umar Syahid replaces Mr. Afdol Muftiasa on a temporary basis to fill a vacancy. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure required under local regulations. It does not involve a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or management change of executive officers. The filing is purely informational and administrative, with no financial terms or transaction details.
